experiment_name: Phase 5.4 Ground-Truth Spatial Grounding & Causal Intervention Reanalysis

CLAIM_FULL_MODEL_SPATIAL_ERROR.statement: H-JEPA full model produces mean body-frame goal error of 0.4881m across paired scenes, with near-orthogonal task contrast (mean cosine 0.0010, angular deviation 90.6 deg).

CLAIM_PHYSICAL_SCENE_SWAP_CONSISTENCY.statement: When physical target objects swap locations between Scene A and Scene B, model contrast fails to reverse cleanly (mean reversal cosine -0.0620, angular deviation 93.5 deg).

CLAIM_CAUSAL_INTERVENTION_MODEL_VS_GT_DI.statement: Hidden-layer activation transplants that transfer model contrast (eta_model ~ 0.41) fail to transfer ground-truth target contrast (eta_gt ~ -0.07, mean error improvement ~ 0.034m).

CLAIM_CANDIDATE_VS_NORM_MATCHED_GROUND_T.statement: In the two complete-support settings (Layer 1 k=2, 4), candidate units show no evidence of ground-truth spatial transfer superiority over norm-matched random controls.

CLAIM_COMMON_SUPPORT_INCOMPLETENESS.statement: In 8/10 settings, uniform coordinate sampling does not yield common support within 5% tolerance across all pairs; comparisons in those settings remain exploratory.
